name: Shared Representation for Repetitive Elements
definition: A technique to improve 3D reconstruction of repetitive objects by creating a single shared Gaussian representation for all instances of the same object type, allowing information propagation (geometry completion, detail propagation) across instances while handling appearance differences via per-instance offsets.
summary: Shared Representation for Repetitive Elements improves 3D reconstruction by sharing geometry parameters across instances while handling appearance differences via per-instance offsets.
